requirement_heading: Documentation drift is a red gate
Pass, skip, fail and error are distinct
Gate scripts preserve the ambient environment
count, exists and aggregate share one contract
Mock database does not silently ignore aggregation
Aggregation SQL is allowlisted and parameterized
Cron day-of-month and day-of-week use OR semantics
DLQ inspection and retry are consistent
CSS bundle exists before it is referenced
No blank page on navigation failure
Domain scaffolding is discoverable and callable
Large slice warning is tested and non-blocking
Admin bypass is explicit and configurable
OAuth state and PKCE are verifiable
Login template proves permissions end to end
Counts and version have one source
Compiler breakage fails before users see it
